applies_to: TSI PresSura Model 8631-CRC-BAC clean room pressure controllers with the BACnet board.
summary: The 8631-CRC controls clean room pressure by modulating supply and exhaust dampers, with a second pressure sensor and two supply flow inputs for monitoring. With the BACnet board it is a BACnet MS/TP device exposing pressures, flows, damper positions, the pressure and supply setpoints, alarm limits, a Status Index alarm code and an emergency mode command.
notes: From the Model 8631-CRC BACnet MS/TP Object Set table (manual page 56).
The table has no read/write column. Access is inferred from the PICS, which lists Present_Value as writable for Analog, Binary and Multi-state Values only.
Units follow Units Value (MV 2): 1 = ft/min, 2 = m/s, 3 = in. H2O, 4 = Pa. Flow is cfm in English mode and l/s in metric mode.
The ranges for Pressure Setpoint, Low Alarm and High Alarm are printed as "-0.195000 to -0.19500" and are kept as printed.

source.title: PresSura Clean Room Pressure Monitor/Controller with LON/BACnet, Models 8631-CRM/8631-CRM-BAC/8631-CRC/8631-CRC-BAC Operation and Service Manual

integration.summary: Write the room pressure setpoint (AV 2) and supply setpoint (AV 3) if the BMS manages them, and use Emergency Mode (MV 3) for purge. Read room pressure, flows, damper positions and the Status Index (MI 1) for alarms.
integration.enable: Emergency Mode (MV 3) is the only mode command. Emergency drives the room to maximum negative or positive pressure, the same as the red EMERGENCY key.
setup: BACnet MS/TP master at 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k baud (PICS).
Set the MS/TP MAC with the MAC ADDRESS menu item (1-127); it only appears on units with the BACnet board.
The device instance is 863000 plus the MAC address (MAC 1 gives 863001).
gotchas: Pressure units change with Units Value (MV 2); in. H2O and Pa only apply when pressure transducers are used.
The device instance changes if the MAC address is changed.
